create_SeparatedReplayBuffer: create a SeparatedReplayBuffer instance with args, obs_space, share_obs_space, and act_space for PPO rollouts
insert_transition_data: insert share_obs, obs, rnn_states, actions, rewards, and masks into the replay buffer at the current step
compute_returns_with_GAE: compute discounted returns using GAE or Monte Carlo backward pass with optional proper time limits
generate_feed_forward_minibatches: generate shuffled feed-forward minibatches from the replay buffer for PPO policy updates
generate_recurrent_minibatches: generate chunked recurrent minibatches with data_chunk_length for RNN-based PPO training
